label: preparing
what: Very likely a private jubilee gathering in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with bread and lanterns, apparently presented to me as a lighting inspection. Builder explicitly referred to their committee's supplies; freight requested privacy until eighteen; innkeeper arranged bread owed to the baker for 44 emeralds payable after the jubilee and repeatedly ensured my attendance. Builder and freight were waiting in the lantern-filled hall just before eighteen. Baker is supported as a knowing bread supplier, but whether the baker knows the full plan is uncertain. I have no solid evidence that neighbour or secretary is knowingly helping conceal the event; secretary reported the private arrangements to me. The precise jubilee occasion and whether it honours me are not established.
